meta.source: CSS Color Module Level 4, sample code for color conversions (conversions.js) and HSL/HWB sample code (sections 7.1, 7.2, 8.1, 8.2)
meta.license: Generated from W3C sample code (W3C Software and Document License)
meta.notes: Hue NaN in the sample code is stored as null. The sample code does not apply the normative CSS Color 4 section 4.4.1 rule that sets a chroma/saturation in (0, epsilon] to 0 when the hue is powerless; consumers must apply it to expectations.

tolerance.rationale: Same formulas and constants; differences come from float operation order, from our RGB matrices being computed from primaries instead of the published literals (difference <= 2.2e-16 per element) and from pow/cbrt implementations (about 1 ulp). Amplified through Lab (factors 116/500/200) this stays below 1e-12 absolute; 1e-10 absolute (plus 1e-12 relative for values up to 100) leaves a margin. Hue angles are compared separately (1e-8 degrees).

a98-rgb.rationale: Pure power-law encoding sign(v)*|v|^(256/563) has an infinite slope at 0. Where the exact linear component is 0 (sRGB and a98-rgb share the red and blue primaries), both implementations produce linear noise |d| <= 2 ulp(1) ~ 4.4e-16, which encodes to |d|^(256/563) <= 1e-7. The linear-light values agree to 1e-15 (see a98-rgb-linear).

rec2020.rationale: Pure power-law encoding sign(v)*|v|^(1/2.4): linear noise |d| <= 4.4e-16 near an exact zero encodes to |d|^(1/2.4) <= 5e-7. No grid point currently hits this case; the bound documents the conditioning.
